paragraphs.text: Acornelia , Fashionable Filcher , is a legendary Squirrel from an unknown plane in the Un-iverse .

Acornelia is a black-furred squirrel wearing a backpack with mechanical arms that deploy from it, allowing her to field such items as keys or an umbrella. She appears to be a collector of acorns and stores them in a tree that has a safe door installed on its surface.
